==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{FP|</nowiki>{{var|post}}<nowiki>|</nowiki>{{var|text}}<nowiki>|reply=}}</nowiki></code>

For linking a [[Wookieepedia:Discussions|Discussions]] forum post on a wiki page. For internally citing a thread, see {{Tlx|WookCite|<nowiki>forum=1</nowiki>}} instead.

===Required parameter===
#{{para| |{{var|post}}}} The thread ID number. This is the nineteen-digit numeric value found after "<code><nowiki>https://starwars.fandom.com/f/p/</nowiki></code>" in the thread URL. Do not include any other text.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{para| |{{var|text}}}} The hyperlink display text, preferably the post title. This should always be specified; otherwise "post" is the default.</li>
#{{para|reply}} The reply ID number. This is the nineteen-digit numeric value found after "<code><nowiki>https://starwars.fandom.com/f/p/</nowiki>{{var|post}}<nowiki>/r/</nowiki></code>" in the thread URL. Do not include any other text, and omit this parameter entirely unless linking to a specific reply in the thread.

==Example(s)==
===Posts===
*<code><nowiki>{{FP|3343172654596280342}}</nowiki></code> will display a {{FP|3343172654596280342}}.
*<code><nowiki>{{FP|3343172654596280342|Ask A Mod A Question}}</nowiki></code> will display {{FP|3343172654596280342|Ask A Mod A Question}}.

===Replies===
*<code><nowiki>{{FP|3343172654596280342|reply=3344233352136625925}}</nowiki></code> will display a {{FP|3343172654596280342|reply=3344233352136625925}}.
*<code><nowiki>{{FP|3343172654596280342|a reply to Ask A Mod A Question|reply=3344233352136625925}}</nowiki></code> will display {{FP|3343172654596280342|a reply to Ask A Mod A Question|reply=3344233352136625925}}.
